en: \[VSCode] Fixed "Open in Terminal" showing only the shell's error when `claude` could not be started: in bash, zsh, fish and Git Bash, a notice now explains why and links to the install guide
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了 `claude` 无法启动时，“Open in Terminal”仅显示 shell 错误的问题：在 bash、zsh、fish 和 Git Bash 中，现在会显示一条提示说明原因，并附上安装指南链接
